D008-D018_h002.question:

I had this burst of energy, felt like I could conquer the world. I was redesigning the menu, working 20-hour days, barely sleeping – and honestly, I didn't even feel tired. I’d be ecstatic one moment, then snap at a waiter the next. My husband thought I was losing it. That lasted about a month, and it really messed up the business.

Now, for the past two months, it’s the complete opposite. I feel so drained, like I'm dragging myself through mud even after a full night's sleep. I find myself dwelling on every little mistake, feeling like it's all my fault, even for things that are completely out of my control. This hyper-alertness, the problems sleeping, it all started right after that traumatic event and it hasn't really let up. It’s not like it comes and goes in waves; it's just a constant presence since then.
